facts.business: BlueStone Jewellery Lifestyle Limited is India's design-first jewellery brand spanning the full spectrum of fine jewellery — everyday, lifestyle and occasion wear — designed around how consumers actually live, with a digital-first approach across owned retail outlets, online sales, and franchisee business.
